projects.title: Volunteering
projects.description: For over 10 years, I have been volunteering to rescue fallen nestlings and injured birds, cooperating with official avian rehabilitation centers and state nature reserves.

content.title: Remus the rook. Fell out of the nest too early and became imprinted/tame during hand-rearing. Non-releasable.

projects.title: my Pets
projects.description: I deeply love all kinds of animals, and whenever they come into my care, I do my best to create perfect conditions for them.

content.title: Alexander is a bearded dragon. He loves eating all sorts of vegetables, but his absolute favorite thing is hunting cockroaches.
Albus is a leopard gecko. He’s a bit moody and really dislikes being handled, so everyone leaves him be.
Goliath is a crested gecko. He grew up to be massive, which is how he got his name.
Olga Vladimirovna is a local common toad. We rescued her from a basement, and she stayed with us for a while until she was well-fed and plump.
Charlie was rescued from the street, and he’s the smartest dog ever! He loves car rides and sleeping in total comfort, just like a human.
Oladushka is a very 'liquid' cat. If you try to pick her up, she relaxes so much that she literally melts right out of your hands.
